key_provisions_or_claims: Publicly Available Exception may support web-scraping of unrestricted online personal data for model development, subject to a reasonable-person test.
Digital barriers such as paywalls or registration require case-by-case assessment of whether data is publicly available.
Organisations must provide AI-specific notification and cannot require excessive consent as a condition of service.
Model providers, system providers and deployers have distinct data protection responsibilities.
Access and correction obligations apply to training data and RAG databases; anonymisation and data minimisation are encouraged.
named_instruments_referenced: Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in AI Recommendation and Decision Systems
Advisory Guidelines on Key Concepts in the PDPA
annotation.summary_en: Singapore PDPC advisory guidelines explaining how the PDPA applies to generative AI: use of publicly available data and consent exceptions in model development, data protection roles of model providers, system providers and deployers, and handling of access and correction requests. Non-binding.
